title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: AWS
providers.scope_notes: Covers Amazon Web Services (IAM, STS, IAM Identity Center, IAM Roles Anywhere, Amazon Bedrock). All features are available in every AWS account; SCPs and centralized root access require AWS Organizations, and Control Tower controls require AWS Control Tower.

controls.name: Service control policy (SCP)
controls.what: An SCP can deny actions such as iam:CreateAccessKey or iam:CreateServiceSpecificCredential for all IAM users and roles in member accounts.
controls.setting: AWS Organizations > Policies > Service control policies

controls.name: aws:SourceIp deny policy
controls.what: Identity policy or SCP that denies any request from outside listed CIDR ranges.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp

controls.name: iam:ServiceSpecificCredentialAgeDays
controls.what: Policy condition that caps the expiration of new long-term Bedrock keys.

controls.name: bedrock:CallWithBearerToken deny
controls.what: Denying this action blocks use of Bedrock API keys; bedrock:bearerTokenType targets SHORT_TERM or LONG_TERM.

controls.name: Deactivate / Reset / Delete long-term API key
controls.what: Disables, rotates or removes a long-term Bedrock key.
controls.setting: Bedrock console > API keys > Actions; UpdateServiceSpecificCredential / ResetServiceSpecificCredential / DeleteServiceSpecificCredential

controls_unknown: Whether long-term Bedrock API keys can be set to never expire, and their maximum lifetime.
Token format/prefix for Bedrock API keys (not documented on fetched pages).
Which CloudTrail field identifies the specific Bedrock API key on a request (key value is not logged).

authentication.summary: Bearer token for Amazon Bedrock created as an IAM service-specific credential on a dedicated IAM user; sent in the Authorization header. Limited to Bedrock and Bedrock Runtime actions and the Region where generated.

federation.details: Backed by an IAM user, not an IdP identity. Docs do not discuss IdP policy.

ip_restriction.boundary: aws:SourceIp deny policies on the backing IAM user apply per request (docs do not show a Bedrock-key-specific example).

lifetime.summary: Until a chosen expiration date; capped by iam:ServiceSpecificCredentialAgeDays policy

renewal.summary: Reused until expiry; Reset key issues a new value.

administration.summary: Deny iam:CreateServiceSpecificCredential or cap age; deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken (optionally by bearerTokenType LONG_TERM) to block use; deactivate, reset or delete keys.

offboard.details: A long-term Bedrock key is attached to its own dedicated IAM user, not to a person.

inventory.details: Bedrock console > API keys > Long-term API keys lists keys with their status.

network.ui: IAM console > Users (or Roles) > name > Permissions tab > edit policy > JSON: Deny * with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp on the IAM user that backs the key

expiry.ui: Bedrock console > API keys > Long-term API keys > Generate long-term API keys > API key expiration; cap with iam:ServiceSpecificCredentialAgeDays on iam:CreateServiceSpecificCredential

reads.ui: CloudTrail console > Event history > Event name filter = Converse

token_format.notes: Prefix not documented on fetched pages.

log_sources.name: AWS CloudTrail event history
log_sources.notes: On by default; 90 days of management events per Region; free. Data events (e.g. S3 GetObject) not included.

log_sources.name: CloudTrail trail / event data store
log_sources.notes: Needed for retention beyond 90 days; data events off by default and cost extra.

credential_id_fields.notes: Key value not logged; key ID field not verified.

anomaly_cues: InvokeModel/Converse volume spike from the key's IAM user

containment.steps: Deactivate, reset or delete the key; or deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken.
containment.notes: Docs do not state propagation timing.

unknown: How a specific key appears in CloudTrail.

calls.log_notes: Logged as management event; key value not logged.

unknown: No whoami call documented for Bedrock API keys.

detections.title: AWS IAM Credentials Added to a Bedrock API Key Phantom User
detections.detects: Access keys or console passwords added to the BedrockAPIKey-* IAM user that backs a long-term Bedrock API key.

detections.title: AWS Bedrock API Key Phantom User Activity Outside Bedrock
detections.detects: A BedrockAPIKey-* IAM user making API calls to services other than Bedrock.

detections.title: AWS Bedrock API Key Used for Destructive or Anti-Recovery Action
detections.detects: Bedrock API calls made with a bearer API key (callWithBearerToken=true) that delete guardrails, models, or logging configuration.
